title: The 4 Best Dog Crates for Crate Training Puppies
h1: The 4 Best Dog Crates for Crate Training Puppies
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for dog crates for crate training puppies, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dog crates for crate training puppies using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: MidWest iCrate 36-Inch Double Door Dog Crate
products.blurb: Key specs: Included divider panel, 36"L x 23"W x 25"H, grows into 41 to 70 lb adult size, Leak-proof plastic tray for easy cleanup of accidents.
strengths: Divider panel is included at no extra cost, unlike some competitors
One crate covers puppy through adult size for medium to large breeds
Easy-clean plastic tray handles the inevitable early accidents
Lowest price per crate of any option that includes a divider
limitations: Divider panel is a simple metal sheet, not padded
Standard wire gauge, fine for a puppy but consider upgrading later if the adult dog is destructive
No wheels for moving the crate between rooms during the day
features: 36"L x 23"W x 25"H, grows into 41 to 70 lb adult size
Leak-proof plastic tray for easy cleanup of accidents

products.name: Carlson Pet Products Double Door Metal Dog Crate, Large 42-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: 42"L x 28"W x 30.5"H, rated up to 95 lbs adult, Included divider panel, Multi-point locking latches.
strengths: 42-inch size gives real headroom for giant breed puppies at full growth
Sturdier latches hold up better to a teething puppy chewing on hardware
Same divider concept as MidWest, scaled up for bigger adult sizes
limitations: Costs more than the 36-inch MidWest for buyers with a medium breed puppy
Bulkier to move during the cleaning-heavy early puppy months
Overkill if your puppy's adult weight is projected under 60 lbs
features: 42"L x 28"W x 30.5"H, rated up to 95 lbs adult
